title: Autoimmune Dementia: Predictors of Neuronal Synaptic Antibodies in Patients With New-ONset Cognitive Impairment
official: Autoimmune Dementia: Predictors of Neuronal Synaptic Antibodies in Patients With New-ONset Cognitive Impairment and Their Relevance in Non-encephalitic formS: The ADONIS Study
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* both sexes
* adult (aged between 40 and 90 years)
* patients with a diagnosis of new-onset neurocognitive disorders (major and minor), as defined by the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5) criteria, with onset within the previous 24 months

Exclusion Criteria:

\- presence of a history of seizures within 4 weeks from onset.
